issues.description: Public method name mismatch for Farm.song-playing API: the problem statement (UML and task text) and the template declare a public method named singFarmSong() in class de.tum.cit.ase.Farm, but the provided solution exposes the same functionality under the name playFarmSong(). This naming difference (singFarmSong() vs playFarmSong()) creates a clear mismatch across artifacts and will confuse students and automated checks that expect singFarmSong(). Files/locations involved: problem_statement.md (UML and task description), template/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java (signature singFarmSong()), solution/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java (signature playFarmSong()).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the public API name consistent across artifacts. Preferred fix: rename the solution's public method playFarmSong() to public void singFarmSong() (keeping the existing implementation and delegating to singFarmSongVerse(Animal)). Alternatively, add a public singFarmSong() in the solution that calls the existing playFarmSong() (or vice versa), or update the problem statement and template to use playFarmSong() everywhere. Ensure the method signature is public void singFarmSong() to match the UML and task text.
